answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments leverage proof-aggregation to terrace identity entropy, effectively partitioning the ocean of potential Sybil nodes into verifiable, non-collapsible domains. By integrating a VRF-based beacon for periodic leader sortition alongside sequential delay functions, the protocol enforces an information-theoretic barrier that renders identity cloning computationally infeasible. This architecture achieves Byzantine fault tolerance by anchoring subjective trust within deterministic cryptographic finality.
